development_evidence.defect: v6 equalized group mass but computed finite-sample ranks from pooled row count; v7 replaces this with group-count ranks

partition.domain_disclosure: prospective same-domain validation with fresh exact coordinates; coarse spatial-domain overlap is intentional

model_selection.selection: smallest budget passing every method-group NRMSE and worst-error gate

conformal.coverage_target: simultaneous coverage of every row in a future exchangeable group
conformal.symmetric: per-group maximum absolute normalized residual; k=min(G,ceil((G+1)*9/10))
conformal.asymmetric: per-group lower and upper one-sided maximum normalized residuals; each k=min(G,ceil((G+1)*19/20)); union bound gives at least 90% simultaneous-group target
conformal.rank_arithmetic: Fraction and integer ceiling only; no floating probability ranks

gates.acceptance: all point, row-coverage, simultaneous-group coverage and group-stability gates pass for interpolation, boundary, OOD and overall

identity.execution: clean detached exact preregistration commit with explicit worktree PYTHONPATH
identity.runtime_closure: actual imported repository module paths and HEAD Git blob IDs including initializers

claims.allowed: prospective same-domain deterministic L0 software-emulation validation
claims.forbidden: physical accuracy, higher-fidelity accuracy, or untouched coarse spatial regions
